description: A JUnit test class 'TrustedCertificateAuthorityTest' for testing the 'TrustedCertificateAuthority' class in the context of TLS certificate validation and decoding, specifically for handling X.509 certificates and related JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: TrustedCertificateAuthorityTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing 'TrustedCertificateAuthority' handling of certificates and JSON data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a self-signed certificate for testing by creating and loading an X.509 certificate.

methods.name: testDecodeTrustedCAUsingPublicKey
methods.description: Tests decoding a 'trusted-ca' section from JSON that contains public key information and verifies the resulting 'TrustedCertificateAuthority' object.

methods.name: testDecodeTrustedCAUsingCert
methods.description: Tests decoding a 'trusted-ca' section from JSON that contains an encoded X.509 certificate and verifies the resulting 'TrustedCertificateAuthority' object.

methods.name: testDecodeTrustedCAUsingCertAndPublicKey
methods.description: Tests handling a case where both a certificate and incorrect public key info are provided, ensuring fallback logic and validity checks.

methods.name: assertAuthority
methods.description: Helper method to validate properties of a 'TrustedCertificateAuthority' object against the loaded certificate.
